deviations.reason: First --write run found 4 dirs with 'no matching index entry', including girard_1989 and van_doorn_2015 (which DO have valid conversions and index entries — created via literature-ingest.sh in Phase 2). Root cause: literature-ingest.sh creates entries with a doc_id/source_path schema, while literature-fidelity-audit.sh's resolve_targets() requires an id/path (relative, sources/<dir>/... prefixed) schema — the two tools use incompatible entry schemas. Fixed by adding id/path fields to those 2 entries (additive, matching the schema every other entry in this index already uses), then re-ran --write, which correctly stamped both. literature-fidelity-audit.sh itself was never modified (out of scope per #839 ownership) — only index.json's data was corrected.
